## Theme Studio

- [ ] Theme Studio opens as a compact workspace plus collapsed sections rather than one giant form.
- [ ] Preview / Code toggle switches views.
- [ ] Preview page selector supports Home, Catalogue, My Learning and Administration.
- [ ] Selecting a source file keeps Code mode active.
- [ ] Preview unsaved changes renders the edited HTML/CSS/JS without saving the draft.
- [ ] Identity, Colours, Typography, Navigation, Layout, Hero, Assets and Advanced Custom CSS are separate sections.
- [ ] Palette and semantic colours are entered as six-digit hex text; no OS colour-picker input is present.

- [ ] Saving one design section does not reset values belonging to another section.
- [ ] Save draft does not change the live theme; Activate / Apply draft does.
